title: Finite sum formula for biased probability
statement: Let $\rho\in\bbr$, let $m$ be a natural number, and let $A$ be a decidable predicate on Boolean words. The biased probability that $A$ holds of a sampled length-$m$ word is the sum over all Boolean words $w$ of length $m$ of the product of their bit probabilities, counting the product when $A(w)$ holds and zero otherwise; each true bit contributes $\rho$ and each false bit contributes $1-\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a predicate on Boolean words
